# Address book density uses scoped semantic CSS variables for coordinated dimensions

Bug 1847427 found that the contact display and editor did not respond to compact and touch density. The accepted patch defines --ab-contact-padding, --ab-contact-photo-size, --ab-detail-section-padding, --ab-detail-title-margin-block, and --vcard-edit-row-gap on the root with uidensity-specific values; consumers use those semantic names instead of repeating numeric values. Current code retains this structure. In these components, name CSS variables by component and dimension, and adjust all related surfaces for a density change.

Scope: Address book density and CSS naming.

Paths:

- `mail/themes/shared/mail/aboutAddressBook.css`
- `mail/themes/shared/mail/vcard.css`
